# Forever Buff Reminder Addon (WoW Forever)

> Minimal, taint-safe Druid buff reminder addon for World of Warcraft: Forever (ByJTT).

- Repo: https://github.com/ByJTT/wow-forever-buff-reminder-addon
- Purpose: show Mark of the Wild / Thorns only when missing; click icon to cast.
- Scope: Druid, WoW Forever. Intentionally minimal (1 Lua file + TOC, no deps).
- Install path (critical): `<WoW Forever>/Interface/AddOns/ForeverBuffReminder/ForeverBuffReminder.toc` (folder name must be `ForeverBuffReminder`).
- Required files: `ForeverBuffReminder.toc`, `ForeverBuffReminder.lua`.
- Commands: `/fbr help|lock|unlock|move|motw|thorns|scale|pulse|sound|reset|test|debug|rl`.
- Safety: secure button casting; no secure OnClick/PreClick/PostClick hooks; combat-safe deferral.
- Issues: include WoW Forever client/build, addon version (`/fbr debug`), steps, expected/actual, Lua errors. Do not include account data or local personal paths.
- License: MIT.
